lead.headline: Holly Springs, Mississippi's city utility never billed 42.6% of the power it bought in 2024, worst of 425 city utilities
lead.number: Bought 240,422 MWh (megawatt-hours) in 2024, billed 137,809; billed fell 224,000 (2022) → 178,000 (2023) → 138,000 (2024) while purchases held at 232,000-251,000; the median city utility loses 3.4%
lead.watch_out: Only 2024 is in the warehouse (the 2019-23 trend came from EIA files pulled outside), and every check is the city's own filing, so a bad EIA filing is not ruled out
